brokers.name: Acxiom
brokers.jurisdiction_notes: CPPA-registered data broker (confirmed present as 'Acxiom LLC' in the 2026 CPPA registry CSV export). Full profile access/deletion runs through the AboutTheData.com consumer portal, which verifies identity with last-4 SSN and DOB before showing a profile.
brokers.notes: Acxiom is a B2B/marketing data broker with no public people-search tool (publicly_searchable=false is deliberate). A simpler marketing-suppression-only web form exists at https://www.acxiom.com/optout/ (also documented at https://isapps.acxiom.com/optout/optout.aspx) and does not require an account, but only the AboutTheData.com identity-verified account flow reaches full profile deletion, hence account-required. Also reachable by phone at 1-877-774-2094. Acxiom states it responds within ~2 days but full compliance can take the statutory 30 days. captcha_required is not confirmed from sources for either path; set to false pending live verification. Owner listed per CPPA registry entity name; ultimate parent is The Interpublic Group of Companies.

brokers.name: Epsilon

This entry is scoped to Equifax's marketing/non-credit data use (promotional mail, prescreened offers, phone solicitations), NOT the credit report or credit-freeze product.

Mail alternative: Equifax, P.O. Box 1025, Atlanta, GA 30301. Separate joint prescreen opt-out for preapproved credit/insurance offers (shared with Experian/TransUnion/Innovis) is at optoutprescreen.com / 888-567-8688 and is a distinct mechanism from this marketing opt-out. Opting out here does not delete or affect the underlying credit file. Not a public people-search site.

brokers.name: Experian Marketing Solutions (Consumer Data Opt-Out)

Email alternative: optout@experian.com. Phone: 833-210-4615. captcha_required not confirmed from sources; set to false pending live verification. Not a public people-search site.

brokers.name: FamilyTreeNow

No account or email is required just to locate and flag a record for removal (email is only needed to confirm). Genealogy-sourced, so opting out removes only the named person's record, not listed relatives/associates — each family member must opt out separately.

brokers.name: FastPeopleSearch

brokers.name: Kochava

brokers.notes: IMPORTANT mechanism mismatch versus QuietLine's usual name/phone/address flow: Kochava's opt-out/do-not-sell page requires the consumer to submit their device's Mobile Advertising ID (MAID) rather than name or address, and requests are device-specific (each device/MAID must be submitted separately). QuietLine's discovery flow should surface this to the user rather than attempting a standard PII-based submission. Full data-deletion requests can alternatively be emailed to privacy@kochava.com or requested by phone at 855-562-4282. captcha_required not confirmed from sources; set to false pending live verification. Not publicly searchable — no consumer-facing lookup tool exists.

brokers.name: LexisNexis Risk Solutions (Personal Records Suppression)
brokers.jurisdiction_notes: Large consumer-risk data broker; treated here as CA-registered based on its scale and inclusion alongside Acxiom/Epsilon/CoreLogic in industry summaries of major CPPA registrants, though this session's direct CSV lookup did not return a 'LexisNexis' row (the CSV is large and the fetch tool may truncate/summarize rather than exhaustively search it) — flag for live re-verification. Suppression from restricted public-records products has an expedited path for law enforcement, public officials, identity-theft victims, and domestic-violence survivors.
brokers.notes: Two distinct tiers exist: (1) a general consumer-disclosure opt-out/request at consumer.risk.lexisnexis.com/opt and /optrequest, and (2) formal 'Information Suppression' requests (the stronger, restricted-public-records-product suppression) which require documentation substantiating physical-risk or identity-theft-victim status, uploaded via optout.lexisnexis.com or mailed/emailed if upload isn't possible. Mail fallback: LexisNexis Individual Requests for Information Suppression, PO Box 933, Dayton, OH 45401; email privacy.information.mgr@lexisnexis.com. Classified as id-upload because the fullest suppression path routinely requires document upload; captcha_required assumed true for the online consumer risk portal but not directly confirmed — verify live. No public consumer search tool (used by subscriber businesses, not consumer-facing search).

brokers.notes: Requires CAPTCHA solve during submission — route to captcha-handoff mechanism. Agent pre-fills name, email, and listing URL; user completes CAPTCHA and submits. Email confirmation link is sent after submission.

brokers.name: SpyDialer
brokers.jurisdiction_notes: Registered with the CPPA as 'Spy Labs AdCo, LLC' DBA Spydialer.com — confirmed via registry.csv download, checked 2026-07-10.
brokers.notes: Consumer removal flow at spydialer.com/consumers/: select state, solve CAPTCHA, continue past the privacy-law notice, enter the phone number/data to opt out, and submit. Name + landline number is generally enough to make the reverse-lookup unusable. A separate business-listing removal path exists for business numbers (not used here). Guides recommend rechecking every 3-6 months.

brokers.name: ThatsThem
brokers.jurisdiction_notes: Registered with the CPPA as a DBA of 'Spokeo, Inc.' alongside Anywho.com, Freepeopledirectory.com, Peoplewin.com, and Family.me — confirmed via registry.csv download from cppa.ca.gov, checked 2026-07-10. This directly contradicts several third-party opt-out guides that describe AnyWho as an Intelius/PeopleConnect property; the CPPA self-report is treated as authoritative here.
brokers.notes: Opt-out form at thatsthem.com/optout requires the exact name/address/phone as shown on the listing plus a CAPTCHA solve, and a confirmation email/link. Each distinct listing (e.g. from a past address) needs its own separate submission. No single opt-out is documented that also covers sibling Spokeo brands — unlike PeopleConnect's centralized flow, each Spokeo-owned brand currently appears to need its own opt-out filed separately (see the 'spokeo' owner_group notes).

brokers.name: TransUnion (Consumer Privacy / Marketing Data Opt-Out)
brokers.jurisdiction_notes: A TransUnion-affiliated entity ('Datalink Services, Inc', per a general CPPA-registrant search this session, reportedly a TransUnion trading/legal name; this mapping is not independently confirmed against the live registry and should be re-verified) appears as a CPPA data broker registrant. This entry is scoped to TransUnion's marketing/data-broker privacy-choices product, NOT the credit report or credit-freeze product.
brokers.notes: Consumer Privacy Rights page (transunion.com/consumer-privacy) lets consumers opt out of sale/sharing and targeted advertising without creating an account; also reachable by phone at 866-310-8783 for opt-out (opt-outs processed daily) or up to 45-90 days for full access/correction/deletion requests. Separate joint prescreen opt-out at optoutprescreen.com / 888-567-8688 covers preapproved credit/insurance offers and is a distinct mechanism from this entry. captcha_required not confirmed from sources; set to false pending live verification. Not a public people-search site.

brokers.name: TruePeopleSearch
brokers.jurisdiction_notes: Registered with the CPPA data broker registry as 'Free Data Services, LLC' DBA TruePeopleSearch.com (confirmed via the live registry.csv download from cppa.ca.gov, checked 2026-07-10). Independent from FastPeopleSearch's registrant despite similar branding and UX — see notes.
brokers.notes: Removal page at truepeoplesearch.com/removal: search by name+city+state, open the listing, click 'Remove This Record', confirm via emailed link. A 2024 Krebs on Security piece raised suspicion that TruePeopleSearch and FastPeopleSearch share a common (possibly China-based, possibly fabricated-identity) operator, but the CA CPPA registry lists them under two different legal registrants ('Free Data Services, LLC' vs. 'Mississippi Tornado Alley, LLC') — used the registry as the authoritative source over the speculative blog post, so parent_id is left null here. Phone opt-out alternative also offered: (888) 838-4803. Reappearance after public-record refreshes is common and well documented across multiple removal guides.

brokers.name: TruthFinder
brokers.jurisdiction_notes: Registered with the CA data broker registry as 'TruthFinder, LLC' (CA DOJ registration #186697).
brokers.notes: Came into the PeopleConnect fold via PubRec LLC's 2020 merger (PubRec also brought Instant Checkmate). Site has its own 'Suppress My Data'/'Do Not Sell' links; support also reachable at help@truthfinder.com or (800) 699-8081. Also honors the PeopleConnect centralized suppression center.

brokers.name: USPhoneBook
brokers.jurisdiction_notes: Registered with the CPPA as a DBA of 'Mississippi Tornado Alley, LLC' — see fastpeoplesearch entry for the full sibling-brand list. Confirmed via registry.csv download, checked 2026-07-10.
brokers.notes: Removal page at usphonebook.com/removal (also linked from the footer 'do not sell my personal information'): name + email + CAPTCHA, then confirm via a 24-hour-expiring emailed link. Phone alternative also offered: (888) 747-4095. Guides consistently flag this operator's sibling sites (see mississippi-tornado-alley group) as high-reappearance because they re-scrape public records on a rolling basis.

brokers.name: US Search
brokers.jurisdiction_notes: Operated by Intelius, LLC, which is CA-registered (CA DOJ registration #537529 covers intelius.com, ussearch.com, and pro.ussearch.com jointly per the registration text).
brokers.notes: Runs on the same backend as Intelius. The brand-specific privacy center form works standalone; the PeopleConnect suppression center (suppression.peopleconnect.us/?brand=USSearch) is the consolidated alternative.

brokers.name: Vericora
brokers.owner: Unclear — evidence ties it to the same operator network as Radaris/Centeda
brokers.jurisdiction_notes: No CA data broker registration found under the Vericora name.
brokers.notes: Reported by multiple opt-out trackers as part of the same clone-site cluster as Radaris/Centeda/Pub360 (see also the near-identical 'Verecor' variant, verecor.com, which may be a further clone — not independently verified/added here). Opt-out form requires the profile URL, name, email, and a CAPTCHA; confirmation email must be clicked. Fallback email contact: mailus@vericora.com.

brokers.name: VoterRecords.com
brokers.jurisdiction_notes: Not found in this session's CPPA registry CSV lookup; corporate parent/registrant name not confirmed from available sources. Underlying voter-roll data itself is public record maintained by state/county election officials, so an opt-out here has no effect on the government's own records — only on this site's republished copy.
brokers.notes: No fixed top-level opt-out URL was found; the FAQ page (voterrecords.com/faq, used here as opt_out_url since it is the sourced, real URL documenting the process) explains that each individual record page has its own 'Record Opt-Out' link at the bottom, leading to a per-record form requiring full name and email plus a CAPTCHA, followed by an email confirmation link (some users report no confirmation email is sent when the record processes automatically). Opt-out removes house number, phone number, and email contact fields only — name, general location, party affiliation, and voting history may remain visible per the site's own FAQ. Reappearance within 3-6 months is explicitly called out across guides due to periodic data refreshes.

brokers.name: Whitepages
brokers.jurisdiction_notes: Honors deletion requests from all US residents. CA residents get CCPA language.
brokers.notes: One of the highest-traffic people-search sites. Listing appears prominently in Google results for name + phone searches. Opt-out form requires first/last name, city, state, and phone number. No account needed.

brokers.name: ZabaSearch
brokers.jurisdiction_notes: No standalone CA data-broker registration found for ZabaSearch specifically; the brand is powered by Intelius, LLC (CA DOJ registration #537529), which is CA-registered.
brokers.notes: ZabaSearch does not run its own opt-out form; requests are proxied to Intelius, which in turn resolves through the PeopleConnect suppression center. Expect a redirect chain (ZabaSearch -> Intelius -> PeopleConnect) rather than a single-page flow. Listing removal reported to take up to a week.

peopleconnect.notes: A single opt-out at the PeopleConnect centralized suppression center (suppression.peopleconnect.us, login-gated, requires email verification + DOB match) suppresses listings across all member brands. File once, not once per brand. UPDATED from the base registry: the old centralized_opt_out_url (https://www.peopleconnect.us/do-not-sell) now 404s and has been replaced with the current suppression-center URL; the members list has been expanded from the original 5 (beenverified, peoplefinders, intelius, ussearch, truthfinder) to include instantcheckmate, zabasearch, peoplelooker, neighborwho, and ownerly, which research for this batch confirmed are part of the same PeopleConnect/BeenVerified network. CAVEAT: PeopleConnect is reported to operate close to 20 total sites (others cited in passing include Classmates, Addresses.com, PeopleLookup, DateCheck, PublicRecords.com) — those were NOT researched or added as broker entries in this batch and remain undocumented in the registry.

spokeo.notes: Confirmed via Spokeo, Inc.'s CA CPPA data broker registry filing (registry.csv, checked 2026-07-10), which lists Spokeo.com, Freepeopledirectory.com, Thatsthem.com, Peoplewin.com, Anywho.com, and Family.me as DBAs of the same registrant. The base registry's existing 'spokeo' broker entry (id: spokeo, parent_id: null) is left untouched by this fragment — it predates this discovery and is not redefined here since only batch-a.json is in scope. Unlike PeopleConnect, no single centralized opt-out tool spanning all these brands is documented; each brand's own form currently must be filed separately.
